headline: Bitcoin Rebounds to $76,000 Despite $1.3 Billion ETF Outflow Exodus
summary: Bitcoin rebounded to $76,000, confronting strong headwind pressure as institutional exchange-traded funds recorded $1.3 billion in capital withdrawals.
why: Bitcoin ETF flow figures are viewed as a key indicator of institutional appetite and liquidity sentiment for the wider digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin price rebounded back toward the $76,000 level.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Spot buying pushed Bitcoin back to $76,000 even as US spot ETFs faced $1.3 billion in net redemptions.
